       j.job_status,
       j.progress_message,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.organizationId}}'
   AND j.command = 'COMPLETE_PACKING'
   AND j.causation_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.packingId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY j.id DESC
 LIMIT 1

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS myt_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00') + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lock_until,
       CAST('{{system:uid}}' AS CHAR) AS session_uid,
       CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       p.packing_no,
       p.packing_status,
       p.is_deleted,
       p.organization_id,
       p.packing_lock_session_id AS lock_session,
       p.packing_lock_user_id AS lock_user,
       p.packing_lock_user_name AS lock_user_name,
       DATE_FORMAT(p.packing_lock_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lock_expires_at,
       CAST(COALESCE(p.packing_lock_expires_at > CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00'), 0) AS CHAR) AS lock_live,
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR) AS gd_found,
       g.gd_status,
       g.delivery_no,
       CAST(g.plant_id AS CHAR) AS gd_plant,
       CAST(p.remarks AS CHAR) AS cur_remarks,
       CAST(p.remarks_2 AS CHAR) AS cur_remarks_2,
       CAST(p.remarks_3 AS CHAR) AS cur_remarks_3,
       CAST(p.di_shipping_method AS CHAR) AS cur_di_shipping_method,
       CAST(p.di_driver_name AS CHAR) AS cur_di_driver_name,
       CAST(p.di_ic_no AS CHAR) AS cur_di_ic_no,
       CAST(p.di_driver_contact_no AS CHAR) AS cur_di_driver_contact_no,
       CAST(p.di_shipping_company AS CHAR) AS cur_di_shipping_company,
       CAST(p.di_transport_name AS CHAR) AS cur_di_transport_name,
       CAST(p.di_vehicle_number AS CHAR) AS cur_di_vehicle_number,
       DATE_FORMAT(p.di_est_delivery_date, '%%Y-%%m-%%d %%H:%%i:%%s') AS cur_di_est_delivery_date,
       DATE_FORMAT(p.di_est_arrival_date, '%%Y-%%m-%%d %%H:%%i:%%s') AS cur_di_est_arrival_date,
       DATE_FORMAT(p.di_pickup_date, '%%Y-%%m-%%d %%H:%%i:%%s') AS cur_di_pickup_date,
       DATE_FORMAT(p.di_validity_of_collection, '%%Y-%%m-%%d %%H:%%i:%%s') AS cur_di_validity_of_collection,
       CAST(p.di_tracking_number AS CHAR) AS cur_di_tracking_number,
       CAST(p.di_freight_charges AS CHAR) AS cur_di_freight_charges,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM packing_jz8m9w3h_sub s
         WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND s.packing_id = {{node:code_node_KSguard.data.packingId}}
           AND s.is_deleted = 0) AS item_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub l
         WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND l.goods_delivery_id = g.id
           AND l.is_deleted = 0
           AND l.material_id IS NOT NULL
           AND l.material_id <> ''
           AND COALESCE(l.picking_status, '') <> 'Cancelled'
           AND l.gd_qty > 0
           AND COALESCE(l.picking_status, '') <> 'Completed') AS unpicked,
       (SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(l.material_name, l.material_id), ' (', COALESCE(NULLIF(l.picking_status, ''), 'Open'), ')') ORDER BY l.id SEPARATOR '; '), '; ', 3)
          FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub l
         WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND l.goods_delivery_id = g.id
           AND l.is_deleted = 0
           AND l.material_id IS NOT NULL
           AND l.material_id <> ''
           AND COALESCE(l.picking_status, '') <> 'Cancelled'
           AND l.gd_qty > 0
           AND COALESCE(l.picking_status, '') <> 'Completed') AS unpicked_names,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM item i
         WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND i.is_deleted = 0
           AND i.stock_control = 1
           AND i.id IN (SELECT s.item_code
                          FROM packing_jz8m9w3h_sub s
                         WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                           AND s.packing_id = {{node:code_node_KSguard.data.packingId}}
                           AND s.is_deleted = 0)
           AND (i.based_uom IS NULL
             OR i.serial_number_management IS NULL OR i.serial_number_management <> 0
             OR i.item_batch_management IS NULL
             OR i.material_costing_method IS NULL OR i.material_costing_method NOT IN ('Fixed Cost', 'First In First Out', 'Weighted Average')
             OR (i.material_costing_method = 'Fixed Cost' AND i.purchase_unit_price IS NULL))) AS bad_items,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM item i
         WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND i.is_deleted = 0
           AND i.stock_control = 1
           AND i.id IN (SELECT s.item_code
                          FROM packing_jz8m9w3h_sub s
                         WHERE s.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                           AND s.packing_id = {{node:code_node_KSguard.data.packingId}}
                           AND s.is_deleted = 0)
           AND ((i.item_batch_management = 0
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                               FROM item_batch_balance b
                              WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                                AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.organizationId}}'
                                AND b.plant_id = g.plant_id
                                AND b.is_deleted = 0
                                AND b.material_id = i.id
                                AND (b.location_id IN (SELECT r.bin_location
                                                         FROM on_reserved_gd r
                                                        WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                                                          AND r.doc_id = (CAST(g.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                                                          AND r.material_id = i.id
                                                          AND r.status = 'Allocated'
                                                          AND r.is_deleted = 0)
                                  OR b.location_id IN (SELECT h.location_id
                                                         FROM packing_hr4nq20g_sub h
                                                        WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                                                          AND h.packing_id = {{node:code_node_KSguard.data.packingId}}
                                                          AND h.is_deleted = 0))))
             OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                          FROM item_serial_balance sb
                         WHERE sb.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                           AND sb.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.organizationId}}'
                           AND sb.plant_id = g.plant_id
                           AND sb.is_deleted = 0
                           AND sb.material_id = i.id
                           AND (sb.location_id IN (SELECT r.bin_location
                                                     FROM on_reserved_gd r
                                                    WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                                                      AND r.doc_id = (CAST(g.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                                                      AND r.material_id = i.id
                                                      AND r.status = 'Allocated'
                                                      AND r.is_deleted = 0)
                             OR sb.location_id IN (SELECT h.location_id
                                                     FROM packing_hr4nq20g_sub h
                                                    WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                                                      AND h.packing_id = {{node:code_node_KSguard.data.packingId}}
                                                      AND h.is_deleted = 0))))) AS stray_items,
       (SELECT CONCAT(CAST(j.id AS CHAR), '|', j.job_status)
          FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.organizationId}}'
           AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.idempotencyKey}}'
         LIMIT 1) AS key_job,
       (SELECT CONCAT(CAST(j.id AS CHAR), '|', j.job_status)
          FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND j.command = 'COMPLETE_PACKING'
           AND j.correlation_id = (CONCAT('GD|', CAST(g.id AS CHAR)) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND j.is_deleted = 0
           AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_PACKING', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')
         ORDER BY j.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS open_job,
       (SELECT CONCAT(CAST(j.id AS CHAR), '|', j.command, '|', j.job_status)
          FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND j.command <> 'COMPLETE_PACKING'
           AND j.correlation_id = (CONCAT('GD|', CAST(g.id AS CHAR)) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND j.is_deleted = 0
           AND j.job_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
         ORDER BY j.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS other_job,
       (SELECT CONCAT(CAST(j.id AS CHAR), '|', j.job_status, '|',
                      COALESCE((SELECT l.line_so_no
                                  FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub l
                                 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                                   AND l.goods_delivery_id = g.id
                                   AND (CONCAT('SO|', l.line_so_id) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) = j.correlation_id
                                 LIMIT 1), ''))
          FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND j.command = 'SAVE_SO'
           AND j.correlation_id IN (SELECT CONCAT('SO|', l.line_so_id) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
                                      FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub l
                                     WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                                       AND l.goods_delivery_id = g.id
                                       AND l.is_deleted = 0
                                       AND COALESCE(l.line_so_id, '') <> '')
           AND j.is_deleted = 0
           AND j.job_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
         ORDER BY j.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS so_job,
       (SELECT CONCAT(CAST(j.id AS CHAR), '|', j.job_status, '|', COALESCE(j.error_code, ''))
          FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND j.command = 'COMPLETE_PACKING'
           AND j.causation_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.packingId}}'
           AND j.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY j.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS last_job
  FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) o
  LEFT JOIN packing p
    ON p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p.id = {{node:code_node_KSguard.data.packingId}}
  LEFT JOIN goods_delivery g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_KSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.gd_id, '[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED)
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
